formats.key: safeTransferFrom(address from,address to,uint256 id,uint256 amount,bytes data)
effects: Moves `amount` units of ERC-1155 token `id` of this collection from `from` (the signer, or an owner who approved the signer as operator) to `to`.
If `to` is a contract, its onERC1155Received hook is called with the hidden `data` bytes; sending to this airdrop contract itself reverts.
formats.shown: Transfer N of token <collection #id> to <recipient>, with From, To, Artwork and Amount fields.

findings.title: safeTransferFrom: the `data` bytes passed to the receiver hook are not shown.
findings.evidence: ERC1155.sol _safeTransferFrom -> _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck(operator, from, to, id, amount, data); descriptor has no field for `data`. The bytes move none of the signer's assets.
findings.fix: None needed; leaving out callback data is acceptable.

formats.key: safeBatchTransferFrom(address from,address to,uint256[] ids,uint256[] amounts,bytes data)
effects: Moves amounts[i] units of each token ids[i] of this collection from `from` (the signer or an owner who approved the signer) to `to`.
If `to` is a contract, its onERC1155BatchReceived hook is called with the hidden `data` bytes.
formats.shown: Batch transfer airdrop tokens, with From, To, a list of Artworks and a separate list of Amounts.

findings.title: safeBatchTransferFrom: ids and amounts are two separate lists the signer must pair by position.
findings.evidence: descriptor fields `ids.[]` 'Artworks' and `amounts.[]` 'Amounts' are listed one after the other. ERC1155.sol _safeBatchTransferFrom moves amounts[i] of ids[i].
findings.fix: Make the labels say they pair by position (e.g. 'Artworks (in order)' and 'Amount per artwork (same order)'), or group them if the wallet supports it.

findings.title: safeBatchTransferFrom: no interpolatedIntent, so the intent does not name the recipient.
findings.evidence: descriptor: intent 'Batch transfer airdrop tokens', no interpolatedIntent. The sibling safeTransferFrom has 'Transfer {amount} of token {id} to {to}'.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Transfer airdrop tokens from {from} to {to}'.

findings.title: safeBatchTransferFrom: the test case has one element, so the batch pairing is never tested.
findings.fix: Add a case with two or more ids and amounts.

effects: Grants (approved=true) or revokes (approved=false) `operator` the right to transfer every token id the signer holds in this collection, now and in the future.
formats.shown: Set operator approval, with the Operator and Approved shown as a raw true/false.

findings.title: setApprovalForAll: the intent does not say whether this grants or revokes, or that it covers all the signer's tokens.
findings.evidence: descriptor intent 'Set operator approval', no interpolatedIntent; field `approved` format raw renders 'true'/'false' (cases 2, 3). ERC1155.sol setApprovalForAll -> _setApprovalForAll(_msgSender(), operator, approved) covers all ids.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Allow {operator} to transfer all your airdrop tokens: {approved}', and give the Approved field a label like 'Can move all your tokens in this collection'.

effects: Destroys `amount_` units of token `tokenID_` from the signer's own balance (reverts if the collection is not burnable).
formats.shown: Destroy N of token <collection #id>, with Artwork and Amount fields.

effects: Mints `amount_` units of token `tokenID_` to the airdrop contract itself, which holds them for later airdrops (only the owner or a trustee can call). None of the signer's assets move.
formats.shown: Mint airdrop tokens to contract, with Artwork and Amount fields.

effects: Sends exactly 1 unit of token `tokenID_` from the contract's stock to each address in `to_` (only the owner or a trustee can call). None of the signer's assets move.
Marks every recipient as airdropped in a mapping shared by all token ids, so none of them can get any later airdrop from this contract.
formats.shown: Airdrop tokens to recipients, with Artwork and a list of recipients as raw hex addresses.

findings.title: airdrop: recipients are shown as raw hex instead of with addressName.
findings.fix: Use format addressName with types ['eoa','contract'], as the other address fields do.

findings.title: airdrop: the screen does not say each recipient gets exactly 1 token and is then blocked from later airdrops.
findings.evidence: FeralFileAirdropV1.sol airdrop: _safeTransferFrom(address(this), to_[i], tokenID_, 1, ""); airdroppedAddresses[to_[i]] = true. The intent is 'Airdrop tokens to recipients'.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Airdrop 1 token to each recipient'.

effects: Permanently ends the airdrop: mint and airdrop revert from then on, and it cannot be undone (owner only). None of the signer's assets move.

findings.title: end: the intent does not say the action cannot be undone and stops all future minting and airdrops.
findings.evidence: FeralFileAirdropV1.sol end(): _ended = true with no way to reset; mint and airdrop require(!_ended).
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Permanently end airdrop (no more minting or airdrops)'.

effects: Replaces the metadata URI template used by every token id in the collection (owner only).
formats.shown: Set token URI, with the new URI string.

effects: Replaces the collection-level contract metadata URI and emits ContractURIUpdated (owner only).
formats.shown: Set contract URI, with the new URI string.

effects: Burns the contract's whole remaining balance of token `tokenID_` (owner only). None of the signer's own tokens are touched.
formats.shown: Burn remaining airdrop supply, with the Artwork.

findings.title: burnRemaining: the amount burned is the contract's balance read from storage, so the screen cannot show it.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor; the intent already says 'remaining'.
